title: The Kunneth formula for quasi-compact quasi-separated schemes via square-zero thickenings
author: The Stacks Project Authors
source_version: Stacks Project source tree, file varieties.tex, corpus local snapshot 20261011
difficulty_reason: The lemma proves the Kunneth isomorphism for quasi-compact quasi-separated factors, a strictly wider class than the affine-diagonal case treated in the companion lemma, and does so by a genuinely different argument. It replaces X and Y by the infinitesimal thickenings X' and Y' with structure sheaves O_X + F and O_Y + G where the ideal has square zero, and reduces the claim to a comparison of the cohomology of the thickenings, where the tensor product decomposition can be analysed (proof lines 5647-5726). H3: the thickening device and the resulting comparison are independent research-level constructions; the author explicitly notes that the companion proof additionally identifies the maps as pullback followed by cup product, so the two proofs are not interchangeable.
